subject: general
question: In the concept of money supply, M4 refers to ________.

options.text: M1+ time deposits of the public with banks

solution:
The correct answer is __**M3+ total post office deposits**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **M4:-**

 
 
• **It includes all of the components of M3 plus other deposits with an original maturity of up to five years, other claims on financial institutions such as repos and bank acceptances, and debt instruments issued by financial institutions including commercial paper and bonds with a maturity of up to five years.**
 
• M4 is a broad measure of the money supply because it includes a wide range of assets that can be easily converted into cash. This makes it a useful measure for tracking the overall liquidity of the economy.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Different money supply in India:-
 
 
• **M0:-**

 
 
• It is the narrowest measure of money supply and consists of currency notes and coins in circulation plus reserve balances with the RBI. 
 
 
 
• **M1:-**
 
 
• It is a broader measure of money supply and consists of M0 plus demand deposits with banks. 
 
 
 
• **M2:-**
 
 
• It is an even broader measure of money supply and consists of M1 plus savings deposits with banks. 
 
 
 
• **M3:-**
 
 
• It is the broadest measure of money supply and consists of M2 plus time deposits with banks.
